title: Signs in the Sun, Moon and Stars
lead: The prophets' picture of the sun, moon and stars failing when the LORD comes in judgment, taken up in the Gospels, Acts and Revelation.

sections.b: The sun, moon and stars fail in the day of the LORD against Babylon (Isaiah 13:10), against Egypt (Ezekiel 32:7-8), in Amos 8:9 and three times in Joel (2:10; 2:30-31; 3:15). Joel alone says the moon will turn to blood. The images may recall the plague of darkness in Egypt (Exodus 10:21-23), eclipses and dust storms, or the language of political collapse.
sections.refs: Isaiah 13:10; Ezekiel 32:7-8; Amos 8:9; Joel 2:10; Joel 2:31; Joel 3:15

sections.b: Jesus uses the picture of the sun and moon for the time before the Son of Man comes (Matthew 24:29; Mark 13:24-25; Luke 21:25). Peter quotes Joel 2:30-31 at Pentecost (Acts 2:19-20), and Revelation 6:12 puts the black sun and bloody moon at the opening of the sixth seal. Readers differ on whether these are literal sky signs, poetic language for the fall of powers, or both.
